definitions: A surname transferred from the given name.

blocks.text: Pauley is an unincorporated community and coal town in Pike County, Kentucky, United States. Their post office is closed. It was also known as Panley.

Aaron Charles Pauley is an American musician, best known as the lead vocalist and bassist for the rock band Of Mice & Men and the lead vocalist for Jamie's Elsewhere. He was also formerly the lead vocalist for Razing Alexandria.
